newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Telesis Group Q1 oper net falls.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Telesis Group Q1 oper net falls.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTES: PacTel's first quarter 1997 results exclude the after-tax effect of gains associated with lump-sum pension payments of $90 million, or $0.21 per share.
Including these gains on a normalized reporting basis, PacTel Q1 net income totaled $352 million vs $316 million in the 1996 first quarter.
First quarter 1996 operating results exclude a non-cash gain of $85 million, or $0.20 per share, for changing the method for recognizing directory ad revenues and expenses.

Results reflect Pacific Telesis' operations as a stand-alone company prior to its merger with SBC Communications Inc, which closed April 1, 1997, shortly after the close of the first quarter reporting period.
